name: work-governance
description: Composable, tool-neutral governance for goals, planning, delegation, Git, validation, long-running project continuity, project truth, archive curation, and reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Composable, tool-neutral governance for Codex work.
interface.longDescription: Work Governance helps Codex align goals, evidence, decisions, and authority before acting; adapt execution when semantic events change the route; use Plans and SubAgents only when valuable; protect Git and action boundaries; keep long-running project development recoverable; validate proportionally; and report work completely. Explicit decision delegation transfers bounded judgment without expanding scope or action authority, and every module remains independent of storage and tool choices.
defaultPrompt: Use $work-governance:work-lifecycle to align evidence and authority, then adapt execution at meaningful change.
